Description:
Enhance your vintage collection or utility display with this unique lot of 3 antique electrical insulators. This set includes a clear Hemingray-56 glass insulator, an amber Whitall Tatum No. 511 glass insulator (both marked Made in U.S.A.), and a brown porcelain insulator of unknown make. Each piece showcases classic industrial designwith embossed brand marks on the glass models and a time-worn patina on the porcelain. Durable and historically significant, these insulators served as essentials in early telegraph and power lines. Perfect for repurposing, educational displays, or collectors, these authentic pieces come from trusted American manufacturers and offer both nostalgia and craftsmanship. Their robust construction ensures longevity for decorative or practical reuse. All pieces are original, showing minor wear consistent with age, adding to their authenticity.

A handsome pair of substantial sterling silver rings featuring mixed-metal detailing, artisan styling, and distinctive design.
The first ring features a warm gold-tone band accented by a bezel-set faceted red stone. Interior hallmarks include “STERLING,” “.925,” and “14K,” confirming precious-metal markings for both sterling silver and 14K gold. The photographed scale shows this ring at approximately 2.375 grams. The identity of the red stone has not been verified.
The second ring is a wide sterling silver band featuring dimensional geometric and leaf-like detailing with decorative beaded borders and a Southwestern-inspired appearance. The interior is visibly stamped “925,” indicating sterling silver. The photographed scale shows this ring at approximately 3.300 grams.
Together, the pair offers an attractive combination of sterling silver, mixed-metal character, gemstone styling, and handcrafted appeal. Both show signs consistent with previous wear, including surface variation and patina. Please review all photographs for hallmark, design, and condition details.
Total Photographed Weight: Approximately 5.675 grams combined.
Collector / Reseller Note:
The visible 925/STERLING and 14K hallmarks add particular interest for precious-metal jewelry buyers and resellers. The mixed-metal red-stone ring and decorative sterling band may also appeal to collectors of artisan, Southwestern-inspired, and vintage-style jewelry. Stone identity, maker, age, and origin are not confirmed.

Shipping available. Small jewelry lot suitable for protective packaging. Local pickup may also be available according to auction terms.

description: This vintage mineral and rock specimen collection contains over 100 individual samples housed in two compartmentalized cardboard trays. Each specimen is labeled with its name and locality, featuring minerals such as manganite, scoria, smoky quartz, serpentine, sphalerite, malachite, obsidian, olivine, marble, pyrite, graphite, galena, garnet, dolomite, and others. The labels indicate origins from various U.S. states, including some cards from the Texas Memorial Museum in Austin, Texas. Specimens are generally small and mounted or glued on individual cards. The collection is in used condition with visible wear, stains, and possible residue from old glue. Total weight is 2.6lbs. Suitable for collectors, educators, or geology enthusiasts.

description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Glass Electrical Insulators Aqua Blue Clear Lot
This lot includes multiple vintage Hemingray-42 glass electrical insulators primarily made in the USA. The insulators feature the classic two-tiered dome shape typical of early to mid-20th-century telegraph and power line insulators. Colors include aqua blue and clear glass finishes. Each insulator measures approximately 3.5 to 4 inches tall. The pieces show vintage used condition with internal bubbles, surface scuffing, and traces of dirt. No visible cracks or severe chips are present. These insulators are suitable for collection, industrial decor, or repurposing projects.

description:
A versatile three-necklace jewelry collection featuring turquoise-blue accents, silver-tone details, and an appealing mix of Southwestern, bohemian, and natural-stone-inspired styling.
The focal necklace features a double-strand design with turquoise-blue heishi-style disc beads, accented by decorative silver-tone beads, small turquoise-colored elements, and creamy white elongated beads. Slender silver-tone tube sections extend toward the neckline, creating a balanced combination of color and metalwork.
A second necklace combines turquoise-colored round beads with irregular creamy white pearl-style beads and silver-tone spacers. The alternating textures and colors create an organic, artisan-inspired appearance with plenty of visual interest.
Completing the trio is a streamlined silver-tone snake-style chain necklace finished with a substantial polished turquoise-blue freeform pendant. Its minimalist presentation allows the vivid stone-look pendant to take center stage.
Stone, pearl, and metal compositions have not been confirmed. Turquoise, pearl, and heishi references describe the visible appearance and style of the pieces and should not be interpreted as authenticated materials. Makers, ages, and origins are also unconfirmed. Please review photographs for visible condition and construction.
Collector / Reseller Note:
A strong grouping for collectors, boutique sellers, and resellers of Southwestern-inspired and bohemian jewelry. The assortment offers three distinct looks: a colorful double-strand heishi-style necklace, a turquoise-and-pearl-style strand, and a minimalist turquoise pendant necklace.
Display Note:
White jewelry bust, wood slabs, driftwood, and all other photographic props are not included.
Shipping / Pickup:
Shipping available. Necklaces should be individually packaged to help prevent tangling and protect beads, pendant, and metal components. Local pickup may also be available according to auction terms.
